text: The Patriots face the Miami Dolphins in Week 8 with some uncertainty surrounding their receiving corps, as A.J. Brown is officially questionable after missing the final two practices with both ankle and knee issues—a new knee ailment that emerged following his return from injured reserve. Meanwhile, Drake Maye continues to showcase his scrambling prowess, leading all quarterbacks in passing yards on scramble drills this season, a weapon the offense will surely look to exploit against Miami. On the brighter side for New England, the Patriots' starting secondary is healthy and ready to go, which should provide some defensive stability against a Dolphins team eager to build momentum against the defending AFC champion. Head Coach Mike Vrabel addressed the team's preparations in his Friday press conference, while the Dolphins' roster largely lacks familiarity with the Patriots given limited recent matchups between these division rivals.
